title: 20th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2024).
First reading of the Bill amending the Decentralisation Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Isdhoo MP Ismail Shafeeu.
First reading of the Bill amending the Local Council Elections Act (Law No. 10/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Kaashidhoo MP Muntazim Ibrahim.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Employment Act (Law No. 2/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kulhudhuffushi North MP Mohamed Dawood.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Legal Profession Act (Law No. 5/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Hulhumalé North MP Hussain Shareef.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced the decentralisation and local council elections amendment bills, opened debate on the Employment Act amendment and continued the Legal Profession Act debate.
